verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.2: They spoke to the children of Israel and said to them, “Each person should be careful that no one among them becomes a liar.”
verses.3: And that will be his shame in this world. His shame lies in his words; his shame also lies in the things he says. That is his shame.
verses.4: All that is laid upon it will be destroyed; and all that sits upon it will also be destroyed.
verses.5: And anyone who lies in bed will be covered with his clothes, and he will bathe in the water, and remain unclean until morning.
verses.6: And he would sit on the chair that was meant for him. He would cover himself with his clothes, and then bathe in the water. He would stay in that state until morning.
verses.7: And whoever touches the carcasses of dead animals shall wash his clothes and bathe in the water. He must also be unclean until morning.
verses.8: And he would lie in the wilderness, covered with his clothes, and wash in the water. He would remain dirty until morning.
verses.9: And every vehicle that is driven upon it will be destroyed.
verses.10: And everyone who touches anything that is under his control shall be unclean until evening. And those who carry them shall wrap them in their clothes and wash themselves in the water, so that they may become clean again by evening.
verses.11: And whatever part of the body gets rubbed against the sand, and whose hands are not washed in the water, and who wets himself with his clothes, will be dirty until morning.
verses.12: And every root that gets damaged will be destroyed, and every tree will be submerged in the water.
verses.13: And he was to be purified from his sins. He was to spend seven days in purification, wearing only his clothes. He was to wash his body with clean water, so that he could be purified.
verses.14: And on the eighth day, he would take two young bulls or two sons of Yonah. He would bring them before Jehovah at the entrance of the tent of the Lord, and they were given to the priest.
verses.15: And one of the priests committed a sin. The other priest then stood before Jehovah and blamed him for that sin.
verses.16: And whoever comes out of our midst, after having been in the state of impurity, and washes all his body in the water, will be impure until morning.
verses.17: And every garment and every object on which there will be seed spread over it, and it will be covered with water, and it will become dirty until morning.
verses.18: And a woman, whom a man lay with as if she were a woman who has been impregnated. They washed her in water, and they anointed her until dawn.
verses.19: And if a woman becomes menstruating, her body will be covered in blood for seven days. Everyone who touches her will also be contaminated until dawn.
verses.20: And everything that is placed upon it will be defiled, and everything that sits upon it will also be defiled.
verses.21: And everyone who touches her bed shall wash himself with water and be unclean until morning.
verses.22: And everyone who touches any of those things that are used for worship, should cover himself with clothes and bathe in the water. He must also wash himself until morning.
verses.23: And if it’s on the bed, or on the mattress on which it lies, then when it gets wet from being touched, it will become dirty until morning.
verses.24: And if a man lies down on her, and she becomes defiled by him, then he shall be unclean for seven days. And everyone who lies down on him shall also become unclean.
verses.25: And a woman who bleeds blood for many days, without ever stopping to rest. Or if she does stop to rest, then every day of her bleeding will be marked by impurity. After her bleeding stops, she will remain impure.
verses.26: Everything that is laid upon it every day during her mourning period will become unclean. And everything that is placed upon it will also become unclean, just like the unclean things from her mourning period.
verses.27: And everyone who touches them shall be unclean; they must wash their clothes and bathe in water. They must also be unclean until evening.
verses.28: And if she is cleansed from her impurity, then she shall be rinsed seven days later, and after that she can be clean.
verses.29: And on the eighth day, she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them before the priest at the entrance to the Tabernacle.
verses.30: And the priest made one of them a “sinner”; he also made another one and covered it with dirt. Then the priest laid it before Jehovah, along with its filth.
verses.31: And you covered the children of Israel with their shame, so that they did not die in their shame. You covered my dwelling place with shame.
verses.32: This is the law of the Sabbath, which shall be observed from the time when the seed is sown until it is harvested.
verses.33: And she was defiled by her sin, and she destroyed all that was holy and pure. She also defiled the man who lay with her.
